chunk_map.heading: When agents analyse wider, deeper and faster, what is your insight?

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L6 'What does your team bring that the analysis does not?' and L8 'that question': antecedents 'analysis' (L4,L6) and the header question sit in-chunk; closest is L6 'the way building did', a field-common phenomenon the audience walks in holding (rule 3 reasoning), not a missing slide. Harm (unresolvable referent) absent.
grep for 'opening|earlier|last (module|lecture)|said' in body L1-8 -> 0; closest L6 'the way building did' names a phenomenon, not a file.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No 'the X you did/saw/caught' in L1-8; closest L6 'the way building did' is a common-experience effect, not an event in this room.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no demo or guess/reveal beat in body

rules_evaluated.evidence: L4-8: three paragraphs; L6 'So analysis is getting cheap' carries a self-contained claim plus question; slide stands alone.
L1 header asks 'what is your insight?'; L6 poses the same question and nothing in L4-8 contradicts it.

L4 'every interview transcript, every support ticket and a year of analytics' is a list of three concrete objects, not anaphora with empty third leg; L4 'sort them, find the patterns and draft the summary' each verb concrete; no 'Not X. Not Y.', no superlative, no number+retraction, no abstraction-noun stack. grep -c 'Not [A-Za-z]*\. Not' -> 0.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body L1-8 has no compendium/firing/beat/mood/forcing function; 'plant' and 'stance' appear only below the L10 maintainer cut.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -c '[*][*]' on body L1-8 -> 0 (the 3 hits are all below L10).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: slide file inlined by host include; deck presence is the host module's contract, not testable on the slide file alone

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no Phase/Step headers; node scripts/check-slide-numbering.js --file -> OK

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-deixis.js --file curriculum/slides/when-agents-analyse-wider.md -> 'OK — 1 files, no page-geometry pointers across the slide cut.'

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: In-deck links work now; whether they EARN their place is open.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no links in body; has_urls false

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file curriculum/slides/when-agents-analyse-wider.md -> '✓ every slide is within limits'

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L1 header is a question, not a claim; closest to violating. Stays inside: the rule binds law and consolidation slides, and this is a stance plant whose maintainer Guard (L14) says it is posed as a question, never a prediction; the answer belongs to a later slide. 'not every header owes a claim'.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L8 'Keep your own answer to that question.' is closest to class (c) kicker; it restates the header's question but adds a move (hold your answer for the later answer slide), not a koan. No doctrine restatement or design commentary in L4-6.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Header L1 promises the stance question; L4-8 set up the capability then pose it. No old-header bullets; no provenance 'header his' note in the maintainer block (L12 reads first cut).
